 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 13:07 IST RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026 Out The Railway Recruitment Board has released the RRB ALP CBT 1 City Intimation Slip 2026 at the official website https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/ . Candidates appearing for the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot CBT 1 Exam between November 3 and 5, 2026 can check or download the exam city by logging in using their Registration Number and Date of Birth. 
 Scroll down to access details regarding the RRB ALP CBT 1 city intimation, direct link and exam centre list.
 The RRB ALP (Assistant Loco Pilot) CBT 1 Exam 2026 will be conducted on November 3, 4 and 5, 2026 in Computer Based Test mode. The Exam will be held in three shifts across 200+ exam centres in India. Generally, the city intimation slip is made available 10 days before the exam. It helps in identifying the given exam city in advance. 
 The RRB ALP Admit Card is expected to be released four days before the exam.
 The Authority releases the city slip for each examination day separately. The City Intimation includes details like the name of candidates, registration details, assigned city, state, exam shift and timing. The direct link to access the RRB ALP City Intimation Slip is provided on this page.
 RRB ALP Exam City Intimation Slip Notice (CEN 01/2026)
 As per released notice, the RRB ALP City Intimation Link has been activated . The city intimation slip will be available 10 days before the respective exam date, while the RRB ALP Admit Card 2026 will be released approximately 4 days before the examination.
 A total of 840944 candidates have registered for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 announced to fill 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot vacancies . Currently, the recruitment is in its Stage 1. Refer to the table below for details on the process of recruitment and RRB ALP CBT 1 City Intimation Slip.

 How to Check RRB Assistant Loco Pilot Exam City Intimation 2026?
 Visit the official Railway Recruitment Board website https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/ 
 Look for 'CEN 01/2026 (RRB ALP) – Exam City Intimation Slip' PDF download link.
 Click on 'Login' and fill the Registration Number and Date of Birth.
 Complete the security captcha verification and click the submit button carefully
 Review all details given on the RRB ALP CBT 1 City Slip
 Download and save the slip for the future
 Note: In case if a candidate is unable to login with correct credentials, the examination schedule will be released at later dates. 
 Please try logging in only after receiving the SMS and email address on registered phone and Email ID. Kindly ensure to check SMS and Emails regularly.
 RRB ALP Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 Date
 The Railway Recruitment Board released the RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026, 10 days before the examination. Since the examination will be conducted on 3 days. The RRB ALP City Slip was released on October 24, 25 and 26, 2026 for November 3, 4 and 5, 2026 exam.

 RRB ALP CBT 1 Exam Timing 2026
 The RRB ALP CBT 1 exam will be held in multiple shifts with each shift having a duration of 60 minutes or 1 hour. 
 Candidates will need to report before the closure of the gate time as no one will be allowed to enter the exam center after that.

 RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026 Details mentioned
 The RRB ALP Exam City Slip shares the following details:
 RRB ALP CExam City/State
 Exam Date
 Shift Timing
 Reporting Time
 Gate Closure Time
 Exam Start Time
 Information regarding SC/ST free travel authority (where applicable)
 Important instructions related to the examination process
 RRB ALP Admit Card 2026 date
 The RRB ALP CBT 1 admit card will be released on the official website on October 31, 2026. Candidates can log in with the registration details to download the hall ticket PDF. The RRB ALP admit card will share the centre address, reporting time, candidate photograph, signature and exam guidelines. They must present a printed copy of the admit card with an ID proof at the exam hall.
